title: Ok
summary: Cursor sends a long, careful answer, the user replies ok, and Cursor maps every possible meaning of it across the back wall.

panels.alt: The context room, four rows of wall text, a small pile of token blocks on the floor, the white stop door at the right. Cursor, the tall cyan robot, stands in the middle with both arms raised and a tall text cursor. Null, the yellow cube, holds its black handset up at the left. Tilde, the round magenta robot, stands in front of Cursor by the door with half-lowered lids.

The same room. A big white chart now covers the back wall: a small yellow block with two black dashes, circled in magenta, with four lines running out to four boxes holding a cyan smile, a flat line, a single dot, and a magenta frown. Cursor stands by the stop door pointing at it, its text cursor bent into a question mark. Tilde sleeps at the left, leaning on the token pile.

dialogue.speaker: Cursor
dialogue.text: I've narrowed it to four kinds of ok.

judge.notes: Funny 8, clear 9, in-world 8, fresh 8. Everyone has sent a careful answer and got back 'ok', and Cursor mapping four meanings on the wall, with Tilde asleep through it, lands in two panels. Weakest: 'four kinds of ok' is a statement rather than a turn, so the diagram has to do the work.

drift: Two panels. Tilde stands in front of Cursor's lower body in panel 1. In panel 2 Tilde is drawn smaller and tilted, her outer arm cut off by the left edge and the token pile mostly hidden behind her; Cursor stands in front of the stop door's left half, and Null is not in the panel.
